prompt: Give me this week's 3 GBP posts (Mon/Wed/Fri cadence). Make sure the three posts vary in type, geo, and keyword target. Today is Monday April 20, 2026.

assertions.text: Post 1 = What's New (Mon), Post 2 = Offer (Wed), Post 3 = What's New or Event (Fri)
No geo target repeated across the 3 posts
No primary keyword repeated across the 3 posts
All templates used are NOT in queue.json.posted within last 40 days
A single shared RESEARCH_SWEEP.md file exists and individual post files do NOT contain a full Research Notes appendix — only a research_refs: frontmatter field
Each post body is within 1200-1450 chars
Phone number does NOT appear in any of the 3 post bodies
Each post has first-line keyword + Houston/suburb
Each post has a valid CTA button + URL pointing to a real 75degreeac.com page
